timeline.text: My kids' phones change their network ID on their own, so Guard saw each one as a brand-new device — no rules, no limits.
Every rule I'd set just vanished, like someone swapped in a new name tag.
A check running on Cloudflare Workers now spots the pattern and flags the match.
The old phone shows up tagged as a likely twin the instant it reconnects.
One tap merges its whole history back into place.
